title: Enterprise legal turnaround SLA and indemnity decision tree
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a repeatable intake + routing workflow for MSA/DPA redlines that ties legal turnaround SLAs to observable risk thresholds. Deliverables: an indemnity decision tree (automated recommendations + manual escalation paths), updated intake form fields (SSQ mapping), SLAs for triage vs full review, and pricing/contracting guardrails for a tiered fast-path. This ticket consolidates input from legal, sales, and platform pricing and builds the operational runbook and telemetry needed for a pilot with two enterprise accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Decision tree diagram produced and reviewed by Legal (PDF link in links)
Intake form prototype in Console that surfaces indemnity score and suggested SLA tier
Operational SLA defined: triage <= 48 hours, standard review <= 10 business days, expedited <= 5 business days
Escalation matrix documented (sales -> legal -> GC) with on-call rotations and SLAs
Telemetry events and dashboard defined (submission, score, SLA breach, time-to-resolution)
Pilot runbook and criteria for fast-path auto-approve implemented and validated with sample contracts
comments: 2025-02-12 Asha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes - legal wants quantifiable thresholds rather than freeform heuristics. Sales pushed for a 5 business day expedited path for strategic accounts.

2025-02-14 Miguel Rivera: Drafted indemnity scoring rubric. Proposed three bands: Low (auto-approve, standard T&Cs), Medium (legal review, recommended pricing uplift), High (GC sign-off + pricing/escrow options). Attaching rubric in Drive.
2025-02-17 Sofia Kim (Legal): Feedback - 'Medium' band needs clearer language around consequential damages carveouts and subprocessor flow-down. Requested example clause library.
2025-02-20 Design review: Intake UI should surface top 3 SSQ answers that drove the score. Also include 'suggested counterproposal' template for Sales to send to customers.
2025-02-24 Eng sync: Backend will emit 'indemnity_score' and 'sla_tier' fields on intake event. Need API field naming convention discussion (prefixed with contract_).

2025-02-28 Miguel Rivera: Updated decision tree v1 uploaded to Confluence. Ready for legal + sales sign-off; pilot target onboarding 2 customers in March. Open question: who owns SLA breach communications to customers?
next_steps: Legal to provide example clauses for Medium band by 2025-03-04
Design to ship intake prototype (Figma link in Confluence) by 2025-03-06
Engineering to implement telemetry events and a /contract-intake API change (spec PR) by 2025-03-10
Schedule pilot onboarding with AcmeCorp and NovaEdge for week of 2025-03-17
risks: If thresholds are too conservative, sales will face heavy friction and enterprise conversion rate may drop
Automating recommendations without legal sign-off could expose Redwood to liability if wording is ambiguous
Insufficient telemetry will make it hard to measure improvement; need baseline metrics before pilot
owner_notes: Aim to keep initial rules conservative: auto-approve only for strictly scoped, non-sensitive customers. Iterate once pilot provides signal. Coordinate with Pricing on recommended uplift for Medium exposures. Track time-to-resolution and conversion delta during pilot.
